title: Onboarding help: workspace setup for Northwind Robotics
body: Northwind Robotics (C-104) requested onboarding help: their admins have not finished initial workspace setup and asked for a walkthrough this week. Contact: priya@northwind-robotics.example. Account onboarding stage: Kickoff scheduled. Next steps per G-01: confirm workspace admin contact, schedule a 30-minute setup session, walk the admin through workspace creation and user invitations, then record completion in this ticket.
label: Internal

title: Correct billing address on invoice INV-5521 for Bluefin Logistics
body: Bluefin Logistics (C-105) reports invoice INV-5521 still shows their old billing address and asks for it to be corrected to their new office address before the next billing cycle. Contact: marco@bluefin-logistics.example. Next steps per G-03: verify the requester is a billing contact on the account, update the billing address in the billing system, reissue the affected invoice and confirm with the customer.
label: Internal

title: SSO setup request for Cedar Studio
body: Cedar Studio (C-107) wants to enable single sign-on (SSO) for their team and asked for setup instructions or a short call. Contact: dana@cedar-studio.example. Next steps per G-02: confirm identity provider and protocol (e.g. SAML 2.0), exchange identity-provider metadata, test sign-in with one pilot user, then enable SSO for all users.
label: Internal
